# Thiran

> Thiran is PDF markup and takeoff software for construction drawings, made by Tensi.ai (Tensi Pty Ltd). Annotate, redline, measure, compare revisions and count symbols on PDF drawings. It runs on Mac, Windows and the web, with a 7-day free trial.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thiran.app/): what Thiran does, features and pricing (USD; one licence covers one person on up to two devices).
- [Download](https://thiran.app/download): the desktop app for Windows and Mac.
- [Guides](https://thiran.app/guides): step-by-step how-tos.
- [The PDF editor built for construction drawings](https://thiran.app/pdf-editor-for-construction-drawings): Mark up, measure, compare and take off construction drawings in one PDF editor for Windows, Mac and the web. Markups saved inside the PDF. Try it free for 7 days.
- [Sign in or start a free trial](https://my.thiran.app)

## Guides

- [How to annotate and redline a PDF drawing](https://thiran.app/guides/annotate-and-redline-a-pdf-drawing): Mark up a construction drawing with revision clouds, callouts, text and stamps, save the redlines inside the PDF, send a copy that can't be changed, and print it.
- [How to set the scale on a PDF drawing](https://thiran.app/guides/set-the-scale-on-a-pdf-drawing): Set the scale on a PDF drawing or floor plan so every measurement is right, then change the units: metric or imperial, one sheet, one line, and decimal places.
- [How to measure areas and lengths on a PDF](https://thiran.app/guides/measure-areas-and-lengths-on-a-pdf): Measure lengths, wall runs and floor areas on a PDF drawing to scale. Take out voids, add a depth for volume, and see the totals as you go. Step by step.
- [How to compare two drawing revisions](https://thiran.app/guides/compare-two-drawing-revisions): Compare two PDF files for differences: trace every change between drawing revisions (added in blue, removed in orange), overlay two drawing revisions in two colours, or view them side by side.
- [How to count symbols and export quantities to Excel](https://thiran.app/guides/count-symbols-and-export-quantities-to-excel): Count symbols on a PDF drawing with a click each, or find every copy at once, then export your quantities to an Excel spreadsheet or CSV. Step-by-step guide.
- [How to annotate a PDF on a Mac](https://thiran.app/guides/annotate-a-pdf-on-a-mac): Annotate a PDF on a Mac: add text, notes, callouts, highlights, clouds, stamps and your signature, then save them inside the PDF. Works the same on Windows and the web.
- [How to do a construction takeoff from PDF drawings](https://thiran.app/guides/construction-takeoff-from-pdf-drawings): Do a construction takeoff from PDF drawings: set the scale, measure areas and lengths, count items, add your prices and export the quantities to Excel. Step-by-step guide.
- [How to stamp and sign a PDF drawing](https://thiran.app/guides/stamp-and-sign-a-pdf-drawing): Add an approval stamp, a custom stamp or your signature to a PDF drawing, sign it with a digital ID if you need to, and send it back. Step-by-step guide.
- [How to open and edit a PDF from Google Drive](https://thiran.app/guides/open-and-edit-a-pdf-from-google-drive): Open a PDF drawing straight from Google Drive, mark it up, and save it back over the same file or as a new copy in a Drive folder. Works with OneDrive too.
- [Construction drawing review checklist](https://thiran.app/guides/construction-drawing-review-checklist): A practical checklist for reviewing a construction or architectural drawing set: sheet index, scale, dimensions, cross-references, coordination and revisions, with tips for marking up as you go.
- [How to rotate a PDF drawing and save it](https://thiran.app/guides/rotate-a-pdf-drawing-and-save-it): Turn sideways or upside-down pages in a PDF drawing so they open the right way round everywhere, then save or print. Plus how to turn only your view.
